rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation of headline CPI to 4.25%, I must emphasize that core inflation at 5.02% remains elevated, indicating that underlying price pressures have not yet fully dissipated. With a positive output gap of 0.50% and the prevailing global uncertainties, including the US Federal Funds Rate at 5.08%, a shift to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature. We must ensure that inflation expectations are durably anchored within our 4.00% target before signaling a change in our policy stance. The current stance of withdrawal of accommodation remains the most prudent course to maintain price stability while supporting the 7.80% GVA growth momentum.
